fields.reason: Trial 2 is the strongest completed PRIMARY result (macro_f1 0.92965) and uses the MiniLM plus lexical route. The nonlinear lexical candidate is the closest available extension of that route, adding an RBF expansion while keeping the registered logistic classifier, so it is the most targeted next test for improving the primary search score.
fields.review: Trial 1 collapsed to majority ham (spam recall 0.0). Trial 2 recovered spam recall 0.7802 with a modest train-search gap of 0.0327, indicating the MiniLM/lexical representation is materially better. The nonlinear variant may capture interactions missed by the linear model, but it also adds overfitting risk and has no completed PRIMARY evidence yet.
